settings.title: We show up for your work
settings.text: Your pieces get featured in our online shop and at curated events. We put genuine effort into how your work is presented because it matters.

settings.title: You keep the lion's share
settings.text: We believe artists should earn well from their own work. 70% on originals, and we cover all production and shipping costs on prints.

settings.title: We handle the logistics
settings.text: Shipping, delivery, returns we take care of all of it. You focus on making art. We take care of the rest.

settings.quote: It finally feels like someone is actually on my side. Honest terms, no surprises — and they genuinely care about the work.
settings.name: Max K.

settings.quote: What I appreciate most is the respect. They ask before they act, they explain everything, and they never push.
settings.name: Sarah L.

settings.quote: No gallery pressure, no vague contracts. Just a platform that treats artists like adults.
settings.name: David P.

settings.title: Share your work
settings.text: Send us your portfolio. We look at everything carefully and get back to you within a few days with honest feedback either way.

settings.title: We set things up together
settings.text: We agree on which works to feature, how to price them, and what fits your style. You stay in control at every step.

settings.title: We take it from there
settings.text: We handle the marketing, logistics and payments. You get paid within 30 days of each transaction. No chasing, no ambiguity.

settings.question: Does it cost anything to join?
settings.answer: Nothing. Joining ARTCLUB is completely free. We cover shipping, print production, and all logistics ourselves. We only earn a commission when something sells or gets rented and you always know the exact split upfront.

settings.question: What's my share when an original sells?
settings.answer: You receive 70% of the net sale price. For prints and reproductions it's 40% but we cover all production and shipping costs, so there's nothing to deduct on your end.

settings.question: What happens to my works if I want to leave?
settings.answer: You can cancel anytime with 45 days' notice a simple email is enough. We'll have your works ready for pickup within 14 days. No hard feelings, no complications.

settings.question: Who decides the pricing?
settings.answer: We decide together. Prices are set collaboratively and documented. ARTCLUB will never change a price up or down without your explicit agreement.

settings.question: Do you own any rights to my work?
settings.answer: No. You keep 100% of your copyright. ARTCLUB only gets a limited license to show, promote, and facilitate the sale or rental of your work and only for as long as we work together.

settings.question: Do I have to attend events in person?
settings.answer: Not at all. Participation in events is entirely voluntary. We'll always ask in advance and respect whatever you decide.

settings.hero_subheading: ARTCLUB is a platform built around one idea: artists deserve a partner who respects their work, protects their rights, and shares the upside fairly.
settings.values_heading: We treat artists the way we'd want to be treated.
settings.cond_subtext: No membership fees. No upfront costs. We only earn when you do and you always know exactly what to expect.
settings.final_sub: We'd love to hear from you and learn about your work.
settings.final_note: Free to join · No membership fees · Cancel anytime
